reviews.reason: useUpstreamMcpController已隔离connections查询、save/test/discovery/import mutation和结果状态；导出ThirdPartyMcpTab只组合同一个上游连接工作区的表格、连接表单、测试结果与工具发现dialog。请求与状态owner没有混进第二资源域，模块不导出hook/常量混合HMR边界；仅删除真实未消费的view.message解构，不能凭UI长度再改变连接/导入流程。 P21f reassessed 2026-11-17: ThirdPartyMcpTab now uses shared DataTable configuration and explicit page/pageSize selection over its connections, with table column settings and native row actions. useUpstreamMcpController still owns connection queries, permission-guarded save/credential/test/discovery/import mutations and scoped invalidation.
